about: Rule cards of t1: each card switches one rule off in a scratch copy of the submission (lab ablate).

cards.rule: Due dates continue from the last due date of the COBOL version, which stepped from one due date to the next
cards.off: every due date counted from the begin date, like Neuron NG
cards.where_label: day of the month of the begin date

cards.rule: Good Friday is a bank working day in Ticino
cards.off: Good Friday a bank holiday, as in most other cantons

cards.rule: Direct debits wait for the bank holidays of Ticino: Epiphany, St Joseph, Corpus Christi, St Peter and Paul, Assumption, All Saints, Immaculate Conception
cards.off: only the holidays common to all of Switzerland

cards.rule: Bank transfers (UB) are collected on the due date, only direct debits (LS) on the next bank working day
cards.off: every premium collected on the next bank working day

edits.old: return next_working_day(due_date) if payment_method == DIRECT_DEBIT else due_date
